data.title: Codex wrapper places large ParamsObject YAML in child process argv
data.summary: Saving the full interrupted HV recovery (73039 characters split into nine ordered dialog entries) through Invoke-CodexMcpPlugin.ps1 -ParamsObject fails before child start with filename or extension too long. One 9000-character dialog per call succeeds. Observed source passes serialized YAML as -ParamsYaml argv even for ParamsPath. Expected documented stdin or file-based transport to support full-content records without Windows argv limit.
